e.title: PPI（英国养老金政策研究所）：养老金模拟模型与研究库
e.title_en: PPI (Pensions Policy Institute, UK): a suite of pension simulation models and a research library
e.title_hk: PPI（英國養老金政策研究所）：養老金模擬模型與研究庫
e.summary: 英国独立养老金政策研究机构：维护一套养老金模拟模型（评估对个人与财政的影响），并发布研究报吿、简报与政策回应
e.summary_en: An independent UK pension policy research institute: it maintains a suite of pension simulation models (assessing impacts on individuals and the Exchequer) and publishes research reports, briefing notes and policy responses
e.summary_hk: 英國獨立養老金政策研究機構：維護一套養老金模擬模型（評估對個人與財政的影響），並發布研究報告、簡報與政策回應
e.body:
**PPI（Pensions Policy Institute，英国养老金政策研究所）** 是**英国独立的养老金政策研究机构**，自述为「以证据为基础、影响退休结果的研究」。本条目属本轮**养老金政策建模**取向——实测池内 **Pensions Policy Institute 相关条目为 0**，而池内养老金侧此前已在**机构样本**（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[ap7]]）与**数据来源**（[[club-vita]]）上很厚，**「由独立机构维护的养老金政策模拟模型」这一形态缺位**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **43.8KB**，页面标题实测为 **「Pensions Policy Institute | Independent UK Pensions Research」**；⭐ **模型页 `/about-us/ppi-models/`（38KB）**，正文原文：**「The PPI maintains a suite of simulation models used to build up a view of the future, considering the world either in relation to the impacts upon individuals and their finances or the impact to the Exchequer and their cashflows.」**，并写明 **「The PPI’s suite of pension models enables independent analysis of pension policy, retirement outcomes and long-term trends across the UK pensions…」**；⭐ **研究库 `/research-library/`** 与 **研究报吿 `/research-library/research-reports/`（60KB）**，并按类型细分 **Briefing Notes（简报）** 与 **Responses And Submissions（对政策咨询的回应）**；另有 **Report and accounts**、**Funding Research** 等入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金政策模拟模型」这一形态**——**PPI Models 的定位是「对个人财务影响 + 对财政（Exchequer）现金流影响」两个方向同时建模**，这正是**养老金政策评估的标准问题结构**（个人层面的退休收入充足性 ↔ 政府层面的长期财政成本）；对做**养老金改革、退休收入充足性、财政可持续性**方向论文的学生，**这是一条比单篇报告更有结构的入口**（可与 [[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的「典型情形模型」对照：**瑞典是国家机构的自用模型、PPI 是独立机构的公开模型**）。**② 研究库的三种类型（研究报告／简报／政策回应）本身就是「研究如何进入政策过程」的样本**——尤其 **Responses And Submissions（对咨询的正式回应）**，这类材料在学术检索里通常找不到，但对理解**政策如何被影响**很有价值。**③ 与英国侧条目配套**——[[gad-uk]]（政府精算部门的 Ogden 表与公共部门养老金成本控制）、[[ifoa]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]，以及老龄研究类条目可并读。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、模型页正文原文、研究库与研究报吿页的存在**，**但未打开任何报告、未获取模型文档或代码**，因此**不能描述模型的类型（微观模拟/队列模型等）、覆盖范围与可获取性**；**②** 模型页只说「维护一套模拟模型」，**具体的模型清单与访问方式本次未核实**，**故不作「模型可下载/可用」的表述**；**③** 站点为**研究机构官网**，**不提供精算软件或原始数据**；**④** 研究库按年份与类型筛选（实测含 2025 年筛选参数），**本次未统计报告数量**。**核实说明**：首页（43.8KB）、`/about-us/ppi-models/`（38KB）、`/research-library/research-reports/`（60KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取正文；**未打开任何报告与模型文档**。
e.body_en:
**PPI (Pensions Policy Institute)** is **an independent UK pension policy research institute**, describing itself as producing evidence-based research that shapes better retirement outcomes. This entry follows this round’s **pension policy modelling** direction — a measured search found **zero Pensions Policy Institute-related entries**, and while the corpus’s pension side is already rich in **institutional samples** ([[pbgc]], [[gad-uk]], [[dnb]], [[pensions-authority-ie]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]], [[ap7]]) and **data sources** ([[club-vita]]), **the "pension policy simulation models maintained by an independent institute" form was missing**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **43.8KB** with the **measured title "Pensions Policy Institute | Independent UK Pensions Research"**; ⭐ the **models page `/about-us/ppi-models/` (38KB)** states verbatim: "**The PPI maintains a suite of simulation models used to build up a view of the future, considering the world either in relation to the impacts upon individuals and their finances or the impact to the Exchequer and their cashflows.**" and notes that "**The PPI’s suite of pension models enables independent analysis of pension policy, retirement outcomes and long-term trends across the UK pensions…**"; ⭐ a **research library `/research-library/`** with **research reports `/research-library/research-reports/` (60KB)**, broken out into **Briefing Notes** and **Responses And Submissions**; plus **Report and accounts** and **Funding Research**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "pension policy simulation models" form** — **PPI Models is positioned to model two directions at once: impacts on individuals’ finances and impacts on the Exchequer’s cashflows** — precisely **the standard problem structure of pension policy evaluation** (individual retirement income adequacy against long-run public fiscal cost); for students writing on **pension reform, retirement income adequacy or fiscal sustainability**, **this is a more structured entry point than a single report** (compare [[pensionsmyndigheten]]’s typical-case model: **Sweden’s is a state agency’s own model, PPI’s is an independent institute’s publicly described one**). **② The three publication types (research reports, briefing notes, policy responses) are themselves a sample of how research enters the policy process** — especially **Responses And Submissions**, material that academic search rarely surfaces but that is valuable for understanding **how policy gets influenced**. **③ It pairs with the UK entries** — [[gad-uk]] (the Government Actuary’s Department, Ogden Tables and the public service pension cost-control review), [[ifoa]] and [[cmi-mortality-projections]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the models page body text and the existence of the research library and reports pages**, **but opened no report and obtained no model documentation or code**, so **the model types (microsimulation, cohort and so on), coverage and availability cannot be described**; **②** the models page says only that a suite of simulation models is maintained, and **the specific model list and access route were not verified**, so **no claim is made that the models are downloadable or usable**; **③** this is a **research institute’s website and offers no actuarial software or raw data**; **④** the research library filters by year and type (a 2025 filter parameter was measured) and **the number of reports was not counted**. **Verification note**: the homepage (43.8KB), `/about-us/ppi-models/` (38KB) and `/research-library/research-reports/` (60KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with body text read; **no report or model document was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**PPI（Pensions Policy Institute，英國養老金政策研究所）** 是**英國獨立的養老金政策研究機構**。本條目屬本輪**養老金政策建模**取向——實測池內 **Pensions Policy Institute 相關條目為 0**，而池內養老金側此前已在**機構樣本**與**數據來源**（[[club-vita]]）上很厚，**「由獨立機構維護的養老金政策模擬模型」這一形態缺位**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **43.8KB**，標題實測為 **「Pensions Policy Institute | Independent UK Pensions Research」**；⭐ **模型頁（38KB）** 正文原文：**「The PPI maintains a suite of simulation models used to build up a view of the future, considering the world either in relation to the impacts upon individuals and their finances or the impact to the Exchequer and their cashflows.」**；⭐ **研究庫**與**研究報告頁（60KB）**，並按類型細分 **Briefing Notes** 與 **Responses And Submissions**；另有 **Report and accounts**、**Funding Research** 入口。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「養老金政策模擬模型」這一形態**——**PPI Models 同時對「個人財務影響」與「財政（Exchequer）現金流影響」兩個方向建模**，正是**養老金政策評估的標準問題結構**；可與 [[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的典型情形模型對照（**瑞典是國家機構自用模型、PPI 是獨立機構公開描述的模型**）；**② 研究庫的三種類型**（研究報告／簡報／政策回應）本身是**「研究如何進入政策過程」的樣本**；**③ 與英國側條目配套**（[[gad-uk]]、[[ifoa]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在與模型頁正文原文**，**但未打開任何報告、未獲取模型文檔或代碼**，故**不能描述模型類型、覆蓋範圍與可獲取性**；**② 模型清單與訪問方式未核實，故不作「模型可下載／可用」的表述**；**③** 本站為**研究機構官網，不提供精算軟件或原始數據**；**④ 未統計報告數量**。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何報告與模型文檔**。
